links.outcome: Reproducibility of chatbot nutrient estimates across repeated identical prompts (coefficient of variation)
links.effect: Calories and protein were consistent across models (CV <15%). Sodium was consistently underestimated, with CVs ranging from 20% to 70%. Fat and saturated fat were consistent only for ChatGPT-4o.
links.quote: Sodium values were consistently underestimated across all AI models, with CVs ranging from 20% to 70%.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the nutritional estimation accuracy and variability of five commercial LLM chatbots compared to professional dietitians and official food labels, but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
